risk_if_not_implemented: Without Domain Registrar Security, adversaries may move laterally, exfiltrate data or reach systems that should have been isolated from untrusted networks. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unauthorized Modification / Loss of System Integrity (R-AM-2), Business / Service Interruption (R-BC-1), Loss of Data / Service Availability (R-IP-4), and most likely increases susceptibility to Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2), Human Error (MT-9).

compensating_control_1.name: Boundary Protection
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to monitor and control communications at the external network boundary and at key internal boundaries within the network.
compensating_control_1.justification: Boundary Protection (NET-03) provides network-level access restriction that compensates for the absence of Domain Registrar Security (NET-13.3) by limiting attacker reach and lateral movement opportunities across the environment. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Domain Name Service (DNS) Resolution
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to ensure Domain Name Service (DNS) resolution is designed, implemented and managed to protect the security of name / address resolution.
compensating_control_2.justification: Domain Name Service (DNS) Resolution (NET-13) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Domain Registrar Security (NET-13.3) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Technology applicability. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
